title: The fiber of multiparameter persistent homology for simplicial complexes
summary: Vector-valued functions on finite simplicial complexes give rise to multiparameter sublevel set filtrations and corresponding persistent homology. We study the associated inverse problem for multiparameter persistent homology (MPH) of $n$-filters on a fixed finite simplicial complex. We endow both the space of filters and the moduli space of essentially finite persistence modules with stratifications, where strata are given by orbits of natural actions of order-isomorphisms of the unit $n$-cube.
